_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the highest-benchmark model + max reasoning effort each hub AI must use, PLUS the verified fallback model each AI switches to when its primary hits usage/quota exhaustion. hub-daemon.ps1 reads this to build spawn flags and to auto-switch model on QUOTA (see fallback_model/fallback_effort + MODELS.md 'usage-exhaustion fallback'). Refreshed daily by the model-benchmark-refresh schedule.
_meta.fallback_contract: On a 429/QUOTA_EXHAUSTED/TerminalQuotaError from an AI's primary model, the daemon retries the SAME cycle once with fallback_model@fallback_effort, then sticks with the fallback for ~6 cycles before re-probing primary. fallback_model MUST be a real model id callable by that CLI (a hallucinated id silently kills the daemon, cf. the grok-4.3 incident) - all ids below were verified 2026-10-02 against the LOCAL CLI catalogs (codex models_cache.json, grok models, agy models, Claude Code model-catalog cache): catalog-listed, NOT spawn-probed (no model calls).
_meta.method: 2026-10-02 refresh: local catalog cross-check with zero model calls (codex models_cache.json fetched 2026-10-01, `grok --no-auto-update models`, `agy models` with AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=1, Claude Code model-catalog cache fetched 2026-10-01). Original 2026-06-14: hub-upgrade-research workflow (parallel per-provider web search + adversarial cross-verify)

claude.cli_select: /model -> Opus 5.5 (or claude --model opus) ; then /effort max (persist: env CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max)
claude.benchmark_basis: RE-PINNED 2026-10-02 to Claude Opus 5.5: the local Claude Code catalog (fetched 2026-10-01) lists claude-opus-5-5 first in its main section and as the account's current model, and ~/.claude/settings.json model=opus resolves to it. claude-fable-5-1 (Fable 5.1) is labelled more capable but 'draws down usage much faster than Opus'; not pinned (refresh target = opus-5-5). claude-fable-5 and claude-opus-4-8 moved to the catalog overflow section (superseded). Effort scale low|medium|high|xhigh|max; max = no token-spend cap.
claude.caveat: Persist max effort via env CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL=max. Interactive Claude Code is flat-rate (not per-token metered). No hub-daemon lane spawns claude: this entry feeds hub-health, gen-agent-card, hub-usage and refresh-models only. Fallback = claude-sonnet-5-5 @ max, the catalog's 'most efficient' main model, so it CUTS usage on exhaustion as fallback_contract intends (fable-5-1 would burn usage faster, so it is not a quota fallback).

codex.fallback_basis: On usage exhaustion the daemon retries with gpt-5.5@low: kept from the previous pin and still listed in models_cache.json (2026-10-01, efforts low|medium|high|xhigh), i.e. an older model at its lowest tier to cut per-call spend. HISTORY: on 2026-06-17 (account Pro Lite) gpt-5.5 hit a PREMIUM/credit-pool 'usage limit' while the standard 5h/weekly pools showed 100% left, so Simon pinned gpt-5.5 to MEDIUM. UNVERIFIED: whether gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-5.5 draw from the same pool; if the fallback also reports quota the daemon backs off and reroutes this lane's orders to claude. Never pin an unverified id (grok-4.3 lesson).
codex.benchmark_basis: GPT-6.1-Sol (gpt-6.1-sol) = priority 1 in the local Codex catalog (models_cache.json, client 0.159.2, fetched 2026-10-01) and the model + effort already set in ~/.codex/config.toml (model=gpt-6.1-sol, model_reasoning_effort=xhigh). Supported efforts: low|medium|high|xhigh|max|ultra. Pinned xhigh (= config.toml), not max/ultra, to bound premium-pool burn; raise only after checking usage.
codex.caveat: The 2026-06-17 MEDIUM pin applied to gpt-5.5 and is superseded by this re-pin (2026-10-02). hub-health.ps1 asserts model+effort by value: its expect map must be bumped together with this file or its Models check FAILs. Running daemons cache this file at START: restart them to apply.

grok.fallback_basis: grok-4.6 = the previous generation listed by `grok --no-auto-update models` (2026-10-02: grok-4.7 default, grok-4.7-build-fast, grok-4.6, grok-4.5). Used when grok-4.7 hits a usage/quota limit. grok-build and grok-composer-2.5-fast are no longer in the CLI list.
grok.benchmark_basis: grok-4.7 is the default and newest model listed by `grok --no-auto-update models` on this account (grok.com login, checked 2026-10-02). Policy = best model the CLI can actually call; catalog-listed, not spawn-probed.
grok.caveat: Re-pin only to ids that `grok models` lists (grok-4.3 lesson: an unlisted id was rejected at spawn every cycle - 'Couldn't set model grok-4.3: Invalid params: unknown' - and silently killed the grok daemon). GROK_REASONING_EFFORT may be ignored by the CLI; the model id is what matters.

antigravity.spawn_flags: in-window: agy --dangerously-skip-permissions --model "Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)" -i <prompt>  |  daemon (headless): node tools/agy-pty/agy-headless.js <prompt> with env AGY_MODEL="Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)" (needs node + node-pty)
antigravity.fallback_basis: The daemon spawns AG via the agy PICKER LABEL (agy_model / agy_fallback_model -> env AGY_MODEL -> agy --model <label>); the id fields are display/log only, but fallback_model must differ from model or the daemon's switch-on-quota never engages. 2026-10-02: 'Gemini 3.5 Flash (High)' is no longer in `agy models`; fallback re-pinned to 'Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)' (agy id gemini-3.8-flash-high, newest Flash entry). Primary id stays gemini-3.1-pro-preview (legacy raw-API id kept for the hub-health contract; its agy id is gemini-3.1-pro-high). Label evidence: the primary label reached agy's quota check on 2026-08-02 (tools/live/antigravity.log); the fallback label is catalog-listed but not spawn-probed.
antigravity.benchmark_basis: Gemini 3.1 Pro (2026-02-19) = Google's #1 model on aggregate (SWE-bench Verified 80.6%, ARC-AGI-2 77.1%, leads 13/16 benchmarks) per the 2026-06 research. thinkingLevel HIGH is both the max and the default for 3.1 Pro. 2026-10-02: still the only Pro (High) label in `agy models`; the newer entries are Flash only (3.8/3.7/3.6).
antigravity.caveat: Gemini CLI is DEPRECATED 2026-06-18 - AG migrated to Antigravity CLI (agy). The label 'Gemini 3.1 Pro (High)' encodes max thinking; agy's own default is not guaranteed to be Pro, so the daemon always passes --model.
